objective: Iteratively improve the Rust-first GPTgrep product and generic harness with measured same-agent SEARCH advantages over raw-only bare Codex on XL-DocBench.
authority: User project ownership mandate and explicit 0.2 XL evaluation replacement; routine development, tests, CI and delivery within this direction.

matched_runtime.observed_model_substitution: failure or separately named experiment; no silent fallback

arms.bare: Native Codex base, common question/output instructions, complete original PDFs and ordinary shared tools; no GPTgrep Skills, binary, preparation or answer rules.
arms.gptgrep: Same native base, question/output instructions, raw context and shared tools plus pinned GPTgrep binary, generic Skills/roles and complete context-scoped preparation.

isolation.roles: Distinct admitted storage/auth/native state for each reader and judge
isolation.reader_access: One task workspace plus exact common runtime roots; evaluator material, other tasks and controller output denied

accounting.preparation: All pre-query build/parse/OCR/render/enrichment/index costs separately reported
accounting.search: All question-dependent work, including bare raw processing and GPTgrep routing/Decisions

optimization.cohort: Complete enrolled development source groups, frozen before results
optimization.split: Related contexts, URLs, identical hashes and reviewed families stay together; exposed groups become development
optimization.minimum_improvement: Preregister before results; default strictly positive
optimization.cost_constraint: Optional and preregistered; missing required observations block it
optimization.iteration: New isolated worktree from frozen 0.2 baseline plus explicit accepted parent delta

outcomes.operational_failure: Started reader failure is zero and retained in the fixed denominator

release_acceptance.scope: Complete explicitly frozen XL confirmation cohort and matched preregistered advantage; a full-XL claim covers the complete released benchmark

delivery: verified external Git and notes bundle
authorized source/tag delivery after applicable checks
integrity: No benchmark-specific product code, routing, answer-location priors or examples
No cross-question judge state in readers
No private corpus, machine paths or native session identities in public artifacts

retired.full62_evaluation_stack: removed from active source; retained in Git history
